_doc: The S4b frame witness for the Paintbrush edit gesture (transform-correct path verbs), and the corpus's first Paintbrush EDIT case. The selected open path (0,0) -> (30,30) -> (60,0) sits inside a group with the NON-UNIFORM matrix (2,0,0,3,60,30) in pt, so its anchors are DRAWN at (60,30), (120,120) and (180,30). An Alt-press at the drawn middle anchor enters edit mode, and the drag ends at the drawn last anchor, so the splice replaces the path's two line segments with the fit of the drag. The fit runs in document space and its control points are mapped back into the path's local space. The old start compared local flat points, missed, and drew a NEW path instead. The golden is generated by the Rust port and must agree with the Swift port; the law is pinned by the oracle unit tests the_paintbrush_edit_fits_in_document_space.
name: paintbrush_edit_in_scaled_group
